title: Trauma-Informed Practice for Teams and Leaders
before: Many of the people we serve, and many of our own staff, carry the effects of trauma.

turns.text: Many people who come to us have lived through trauma. So have many of the people who work here. A trauma-informed approach doesn't ask anyone to share their story. It asks leaders to set up the work in ways that build safety, trust and choice. This course may touch on difficult experiences, so pause whenever you need to.

guidance.text: The six principles work together. Safety without transparency can feel like control. Choice without safety can feel like being left alone.
How does your division support staff after a hard call or case today?
If this material brings up something for you, support is available, including your Employee Assistance Program and, in the U.S., the 988 line.
